_: What to SAY for a DEBUFF still, one row per ailment. `icon.mts debuffs.json` reads it and `portrait.mts <id> <png> 48 vfx` puts the result in generated-vfx.ts beside the other effects.
_how: Drawn ON a body rather than on the floor, so the middle is HOLLOW or the creature is hidden by its own debuff.
_inks: The game's OWN damage colours out of the stylesheet — ember #C4483A fire, quartz #6FC7E8 cold, citrine #D9A441 lightning, venom #9BD13A poison, amethyst #8B4FD1 dark, bone #C9BFA3 light, hurt #8E2B22 blood — each with a dark and a light either side, because generated art is baked hex and cannot recolour.
how: A single EFFECT drawn ON a small creature: ONE thing centred, seen straight from the side, with a HOLLOW EMPTY MIDDLE so the body underneath shows through. BOLD readable silhouette, chunky shapes, few colours, lit only by itself. Transparent background. NOT a scene, NOT a landscape, NOT a character, NOT a creature, NOT a body, NOT a face, NOT a hand, NOT a ground shadow, NOT text, NOT a border, NOT a frame, NOT a solid disc.

icons.say: a hollow SHELL of clear pale blue ice, an empty ragged CASING with a big open hole straight through the middle of it, seen from the side: thick jagged crystal walls all the way round the outside and NOTHING AT ALL in the centre, spiky facets pointing outward, NOT a solid block, NOT a filled circle, NOT a gemstone, NOT a snowflake, NOT a creature.

a ring of ragged orange-red FLAMES licking upward, tallest at the sides and open through the middle so there is a clear empty gap in the centre, each tongue of fire a separate ragged shape with a bright pale core, NOT a fireball, NOT a solid blob, NOT a torch, NOT a candle, NOT a creature, NOT smoke.

a RING of dark red BLOOD DROPLETS and thrown spatter, open through the middle so there is a clear empty gap in the centre, each drop a separate fat teardrop flung outward, NOT a puddle, NOT a dome, NOT a helmet, NOT a creature, NOT a solid disc.

a RING of pale blue FROST FLAKES and thin rime needles, open through the middle so there is a clear empty gap in the centre, each flake a separate sharp sliver pointing outward, NOT a snowball, NOT a solid blob, NOT a cloud, NOT a creature, NOT a gemstone.

a RING of short jagged pale gold LIGHTNING forks crackling outward, open through the middle so there is a clear empty gap in the centre, each fork a separate sharp zigzag with a white-hot core, NOT flames, NOT fire, NOT a cloud, NOT a plate, NOT a creature, NOT a solid disc.

a RING of swollen sickly green BUBBLES, open through the middle so there is a clear empty gap in the centre, each bubble a separate round blister and some of them burst open, NOT a skull, NOT a face, NOT a creature, NOT a plant, NOT a solid disc.

a RING of thin ragged dark violet SMOKE tendrils curling outward, open through the middle so there is a clear empty gap in the centre, each tendril a separate torn wisp, NOT a creature, NOT a face, NOT a ghost, NOT a hand, NOT a solid disc.

a ring of thin pale bone-white CRACKS radiating outward from an empty middle like broken glaze, sharp hairline splits with nothing filling the centre, NOT a solid circle, NOT a sun, NOT a star, NOT a web, NOT a creature, NOT a face.
